verses.text: Den Zophar di Naamathite answer say,
“Dem no suppose answer di plenty words? Man wey full of talk suppose dey right?
Your boasting go make people keep quiet? When you mock, nobody go make you shame?
Because you talk say, ‘My teaching pure, and I clean for your eyes.’
But oh, if God go talk and open im lips against you,
and show you di secrets of wisdom! Because true wisdom get two sides. So know say God dey ask less from you than your wrong deserve.
You fit understand di deep things of God? You fit find out di limits of di Almighty?
Dem high like heaven, wetin you fit do? Dem deeper pass Sheol, wetin you fit know?
Dem measure long pass di earth and wide pass di sea.
If e pass by, or lock up, or call person to judgment, who go fit stop am?
Because e know empty men. E see wickedness too, even when e no think about am.
Man wey get empty head go turn wise when wild donkey pikin dem born as man.
If you set your heart right, stretch your hands toward am.
If wickedness dey your hand, throw am far. No let wrong stay inside your tents.
Sure sure den you go lift your face without spot. Yes, you go stand strong and you no go fear,
because you go forget your suffering. You go remember am like water wey don pass.
Your life go clear pass midday. Even di darkness go be like morning.
You go dey safe because hope dey. Yes, you go look round you and rest for peace.
You go lie down too and nobody go make you fear. Yes, plenty people go beg for your favor.
But di eyes of di wicked go fail. Dem no go get way to run. Dem hope na to give up dem spirit.”
Den Job answer say,
“No doubt, na una be di people, and wisdom go die with una.
But I get understanding like una. I no small pass una. Yes, who no know dis kind things?
I be like person wey im neighbor dey laugh at, me wey call God and e answer. Di righteous, di blameless man, na joke.
For di thought of person wey dey comfortable, shame dey for person wey dey suffer. E dey ready for dem wey im foot dey slip.
Di tents of robbers dey prosper, and dem wey dey provoke God dey safe, dem wey carry dem god for dem hands.
But ask di animals now, and dem go teach you, di birds of di sky, and dem go tell you.
Or talk to di earth, and e go teach you. Di fish of di sea go tell you.
Who no know say for all dis ones, di hand of di Lord don do dis,
di one wey life of every living thing dey im hand, di breath of all mankind?
Di ear no dey test words, like how mouth dey taste food?
Wisdom dey with old men, and understanding dey with long life.
Wisdom and power dey with God. E get advice and understanding.
Look, e dey break down, and dem no fit build am again. E dey lock man up, and nobody fit open.
Look, e dey hold back di waters, and dem dry up. Again, e dey send dem out, and dem dey overturn di earth.
Strength and wisdom dey with am. Di deceived and di deceiver na im own.
E dey lead advisers away naked. E dey make judges fools.
E dey loosen di rope of kings. E dey tie belt round dem waist.
E dey lead priests away naked and dey overthrow di mighty.
E dey remove di speech of dem wey people trust and dey take away di understanding of di elders.
E dey pour shame on princes and dey loosen di belt of di strong.
E dey uncover deep things from darkness and dey bring out di shadow of death to light.
E dey make nations plenty, and e dey destroy dem. E dey make nations big, and e dey lead dem as prisoners.
E dey take away understanding from di chiefs of di people of di earth and make dem waka for wilderness where no road dey.
Dem dey grope for dark without light. E dey make dem stagger like drunk man.”
“Look, my eye don see all dis. My ear don hear am and understand.
Wetin una know, I know am too. I no small pass una.
Sure sure I go talk to di Almighty. I wan argue my case with God.
But una na people wey dey make lies. Una all na useless doctors.
Oh, if una go keep completely quiet! Den una go be wise.
Hear my argument now. Listen to di pleading of my lips.
Una go talk wrong for God and talk deceit for am?
Una go show favor to am? Una go argue for God?
E go good say e search una out? Or like how person dey deceive man, una go deceive am?
E go surely correct una, if una dey show favor for secret.
Im greatness no go frighten una, and im fear no go fall on una?
Una famous sayings na proverbs of ashes. Una defenses na defenses of clay.
Keep quiet! Leave me alone, make I talk. Make wetin go come on me come.
Why I go take my flesh put for my teeth and put my life for my hand?
Look, e go kill me. I no get hope. Still I go defend my ways before am.
Dis one go be my salvation too, say godless man no fit come before am.
Listen well to my speech. Make my words dey una ears.
Look now, I don arrange my case. I know say I dey righteous.
Who be di one wey go argue with me? Because den I go keep quiet and give up my spirit.
Only no do two things to me, den I no go hide from your face:
remove your hand far from me. No make your terror frighten me.
Den call, and I go answer, or make I talk, and you answer me.
How many na my wrongs and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
Why you dey hide your face and dey count me as your enemy?
You go frighten leaf wey wind dey drive? You go chase dry grass?
Because you dey write bitter things against me and make me inherit di wrongs of my youth.
You put my feet inside stocks too and dey watch all my paths. You set limit for di soles of my feet,
even though I dey rot like rotten thing, like cloth wey moth don eat.”
“Man wey woman born get few days, and e full of trouble.
E dey come out like flower, and dem dey cut am down. E dey run away like shadow and no dey stay.
You dey open your eyes on person like dat and bring me enter judgment with you?
Who fit bring clean thing out of dirty thing? Nobody.
Since im days dey decided, di number of im months dey with you, and you don set im limits wey e no fit pass,
look away from am so dat e go rest, until e finish im day like hired worker.
Because hope dey for tree, if dem cut am down, say e go sprout again and im young branch no go finish.
Even if im root old for di earth and im stump die for di ground,
still through di smell of water e go bud and put out branches like young plant.
But man dey die and dey lie low. Yes, man dey give up im spirit, and where e dey?
As water dey finish from di sea and di river dey dry up,
so man dey lie down and no dey rise. Until di heavens no dey again, dem no go wake or dem no go rise from dem sleep.
Oh, if you go hide me for Sheol, if you go cover me until your anger pass, if you go set time for me and remember me!
If man die, e go live again? All di days of my hard fight I go wait, until my release come.
You go call, and I go answer you. You go long for di work of your hands.
But now you dey count my steps. You no dey watch over my sin?
My disobedience dey sealed inside bag. You dey wrap up my wrong.
But di mountain wey dey fall go turn to nothing. Di rock go move from im place.
Water dey wear stones down. Im flood dey wash away di dust of di earth. So you dey destroy di hope of man.
You dey win am forever, and e dey pass. You dey change im face and send am away.
Im sons dey come to honor, and e no know. Dem dey bring dem low, but e no see am for dem.
But im flesh on am dey pain, and im soul inside am dey mourn.”
Den Eliphaz di Temanite answer say,
“Wise man suppose answer with empty knowledge and fill im belly with east wind?
E suppose argue with useless talk, or with speeches wey no go do good?
Yes, you dey remove fear and dey stop devotion before God.
Because your wrong dey teach your mouth, and you dey choose di language of di crafty.
Your own mouth dey condemn you, no be me. Yes, your own lips dey witness against you.
You be di first man wey dem born? Or dem bring you out before di hills?
You don hear God secret advice? You dey keep wisdom for yourself only?
Wetin you know wey we no know? Wetin you understand wey no dey with us?
Gray-haired men and very old men dey with us, wey old pass your papa.
God comfort too small for you, even di word wey dey treat you gently?
Why your heart dey carry you go? Why your eyes dey flash,
so dat you turn your spirit against God and let dis kind words come out of your mouth?
Wetin be man, say e go be clean? Di one wey woman born, say e go be righteous?
Look, e no put trust for im holy ones. Yes, di heavens no clean for im sight.
How much less di one wey disgusting and corrupt, man wey dey drink wrong like water!
I go show you, listen to me. Wetin I don see I go tell am,
wetin wise men don tell from dem papa dem and no hide am,
dem wey di land dey give alone, and no stranger pass among dem.
Di wicked man dey suffer pain all im days, even di number of years wey dem keep for di oppressor.
Sound of terrors dey im ears. For peace di destroyer go come on am.
E no believe say e go return from darkness. Sword dey wait for am.
E dey waka go find bread, dey talk say, ‘Where e dey?’ E know say di day of darkness dey ready near am.
Trouble and pain dey make am fear. Dem dey win am, like king wey ready for battle.
Because e don stretch im hand against God and dey behave proud against di Almighty,
e dey run at am with hard neck, with di thick parts of im shields,
because e don cover im face with im fat and gather fat on im thighs.
E don stay for empty cities, for houses wey nobody dey stay, wey ready to turn to heaps.
E no go be rich, and im property no go last, and dem produce no go bend to di ground.
E no go leave darkness. Flame go dry im branches. By di breath of im mouth e go go.
Make e no trust for emptiness, dey deceive imself, because emptiness go be im reward.
E go finish before im time, and im branch no go green.
E go shake off im unripe grape like di vine and throw off im flower like di olive tree.
Because di group of di godless go dey empty, and fire go burn di tents of bribe.
Dem dey conceive trouble and dey born wrong. Dem heart dey prepare deceit.”
Den Job answer say,
“I don hear plenty dis kind things. Una all na miserable comforters!
Empty words go ever finish? Or wetin dey provoke you say you dey answer?
I fit talk like you too, if you dey my place. I fit join words together against you and shake my head at you.
But I for strengthen you with my mouth. Di comfort of my lips for ease you.
Even if I talk, my grief no go ease. Even if I keep quiet, how e go ease me?
But now, God, you don wear me out well well. You don make all my group empty.
You don make me shrink. Dis na witness against me. My thin body dey stand up against me and dey witness to my face.
E don tear me for im anger and hate me. E don gnash im teeth at me. My enemy dey sharpen im eyes on me.
Dem don open dem mouth wide at me. Dem don slap my cheek with shame. Dem gather together against me.
God dey give me to di ungodly and dey throw me into di hands of di wicked.
I dey at ease, and e break me apart. Yes, e don hold me for neck and smash me to pieces. E don set me up as im target too.
Im archers dey round me. E dey cut my kidneys apart and no dey spare. E dey pour out my bile for ground.
E dey break me with wound after wound. E dey run at me like warrior.
I don sew sackcloth on my skin and don put my strength for dust.
My face red with crying. Deep darkness dey on my eyelids,
even though no violence dey my hands, and my prayer pure.
Earth, no cover my blood. Make my cry no get resting place.
Even now, look, my witness dey heaven. Di one wey dey speak for me dey high.
My friends dey laugh at me. My eye dey pour tears to God,
so dat e go defend di right of man before God, and of person with im neighbor!
Because when few years don pass, I go go di way wey I no go return.”
“My spirit don finish. My days don end. Di grave dey ready for me.
Sure sure mockers dey with me. My eye dey stay for dem provoking.
Now give pledge. Put security for me with yourself. Who go shake hands with me?
Because you don hide dem heart from understanding. So you no go lift dem up.
Di one wey dey sell im friends as prey, even im pikin dem eyes go fail.
But e don make me dem proverb among di people. Dem dey spit for my face.
My eye dim too because of sorrow. All my body parts na like shadow.
Honest men go shock at dis. Di innocent go rise up against di godless.
Still di righteous go hold im way. Di one wey get clean hands go grow stronger and stronger.
But as for una all, come again now. I no go find wise man among una.
My days don pass. My plans don break, even di thoughts of my heart.
Dem dey change night to day, dey talk say, ‘Light dey near darkness.’
If I dey look for Sheol as my house, if I don spread my bed for darkness,
if I don talk to rot say, ‘You be my papa,’ to worm say, ‘You be my mama and my sister,’
where den my hope dey? Who go see my hope?
E go go down to di bars of Sheol, when rest go dey for dust.”
Den Bildad di Shuhite answer say,
“How long you go dey hunt for words? Think, and after dat we go talk.
Why dem dey count us like animals and we don become dirty for your eyes?
You wey dey tear yourself for anger, di earth go dey abandoned for you? Or di rock go move from im place?
Yes, di light of di wicked go put out. Di spark of im fire no go shine.
Di light go dark for im tent. Im lamp above am go put out.
Di steps of im strength go shorten. Im own plan go throw am down.
Because im own feet don throw am inside net, and e dey waka enter im mesh.
Trap go catch am by di heel. Snare go hold am.
Rope dey hidden for am for ground, trap for am for di road.
Terrors go frighten am for every side and chase am for im heels.
Hunger go finish im strength. Disaster go ready for im side.
Di parts of im body go finish. Di firstborn of death go eat im parts.
Dem go pull am out of im tent wey e trust. Dem go bring am to di king of terrors.
Wetin no be im own go stay for im tent. Sulfur go scatter on im home.
Im roots go dry below. Above, im branch go cut off.
Im memory go perish from di earth. E no go get name for di street.
Dem go drive am from light enter darkness and chase am out of di world.
E no go get son or grandson among im people, or anybody wey remain where e dey stay.
Dem wey come after go shock at im day, like how dem wey go before dey fear.
Sure sure, na so di homes of di wicked be. Dis na di place of di one wey no know God.”
Den Job answer say,
“How long una go vex my soul and crush me with words?
Una don insult me ten times. Una no shame say una dey attack me.
If e true say I don make mistake, my mistake remain with me.
If una go really make una self big against me and use my shame argue against me,
know now say God don turn me upside down for my case and don surround me with im net.
Look, I cry out about wrong, but nobody hear me. I cry for help, but no justice dey.
E don wall up my way so dat I no fit pass, and e don put darkness for my paths.
E don strip me of my glory and take di crown from my head.
E don break me down for every side, and I don go. E don pull out my hope like tree.
E don light im anger against me too. E dey count me as one of im enemies.
Im troops dey come together and dey build road against me and camp round my tent.
E don put my brothers far from me. Di people wey I know don turn strangers to me.
My family don go away. My close friends don forget me.
Dem wey dey stay for my house and my maids dey count me as stranger. I be foreigner for dem eyes.
I dey call my servant, and e no dey answer me, even though I dey beg am with my mouth.
My breath strange to my wife. I dey disgust di pikin dem of my own mama.
Even small pikin dem dey look me down. If I stand up, dem dey talk against me.
All my close friends hate me. Dem wey I love don turn against me.
My bones dey stick to my skin and to my flesh. I don escape by di skin of my teeth.
Have pity on me, have pity on me, my friends, because God hand don touch me.
Why una dey chase me like God, and no satisfy with my flesh?
Oh, if dem fit write my words now! Oh, if dem fit put dem inside book!
Make dem carve dem with iron pen and lead for rock forever!
But as for me, I know say my Redeemer dey alive. For di end, e go stand on di earth.
After dem don destroy my skin, den for my flesh I go see God,
wey I, even I, go see for my side. My eyes go see, and no be like stranger. My heart don finish inside me.
If una talk say, ‘How we go chase am!’ Since di root of di matter dey inside me,
fear di sword, because anger dey bring di punishment of di sword, so dat una go know say judgment dey.”
Den Zophar di Naamathite answer say,
“So my thoughts dey answer me, even because of di hurry wey dey inside me.
I don hear di correction wey dey put me for shame. Di spirit of my understanding dey answer me.
Una no know dis from long time, since dem put man for earth,
say di winning of di wicked short, di joy of di godless na only for moment?
Even if im height reach heaven and im head touch di clouds,
still e go perish forever like im own dung. Dem wey don see am go talk say, ‘Where e dey?’
E go fly away like dream, and dem no go find am. Yes, dem go chase am away like vision of di night.
Di eye wey see am no go see am again, and im place no go see am again.
Im pikin dem go look for di poor man favor. Im hands go give back im wealth.
Im bones full of im youth, but e go lie down with am for dust.
Even though wickedness sweet for im mouth, even though e hide am under im tongue,
even though e spare am and no wan let am go, but keep am inside im mouth,
still im food for im belly don turn. Na poison of snakes inside am.
E don swallow riches, and e go vomit dem again. God go throw dem out of im belly.
E go suck di poison of snakes. Di viper tongue go kill am.
E no go look di rivers, di flowing streams of honey and butter.
Wetin e work for, e go give back, and e no go swallow am. According to di property wey e don get, e no go rejoice.
Because e don oppress and leave di poor. E don take house by force, and e no go build am up.
Because e no know quietness inside am, e no go save anything of wetin e enjoy.
Nothing remain wey e no eat, so im good fortune no go last.
For di fullness of im plenty, e go dey trouble. Di hand of everybody wey dey misery go come on am.
When e wan fill im belly, God go throw di fierceness of im anger on am. E go rain on am as e dey eat.
E go run from di iron weapon. Di bronze bow go pierce am.
E pull am out, and e come out of im body. Yes, di shining point come out of im bile. Terrors dey on am.
All darkness dey kept for im treasures. Fire wey nobody blow go eat am. E go finish wetin remain for im tent.
Di heavens go show im wrong. Di earth go rise up against am.
Di increase of im house go go. Im goods go flow away for di day of im anger.
Dis na di share of wicked man from God, di inheritance wey God appoint for am.”
